name: The intraday system (5m)
hypothesis: A second timeframe carries edges the daily and 15m books cannot see: five USDT majors on 5-minute bars, one hypothesis per file.
mechanism: 5-minute bars, five USDT majors, cached indicator panels, one file per hypothesis.
data: 5m candles, five USDT majors, downloaded and cached by quantlab_intraday.prepare
indicator panels keyed by a digest of the OHLCV stream they were built from

helped.what: One harness for every hypothesis - same blocks, same costs, same sealed window, same cost decomposition
helped.effect: the only reason two hypotheses in this system are comparable at all; a new idea is one file and one command

helped.what: An idempotent prepare whose cache key is a digest of the candles
helped.effect: a panel is rebuilt only when the candles it was built from changed, so a stale panel is discarded rather than served

helped.what: Sizing the trade by how strong the signal is
helped.effect: adopted because the measured response is monotone, not because it sounded right

helped.what: A market-wide gate that exists in BOTH halves via the warm-up
helped.effect: a strategy that forgets the warm-up gate now cannot trade the warm-up, so training and forward see the same rule

hurt.effect: nothing closes because of the clock - this market has no bell, and the rule that assumed one was measuring a different market

hurt.what: A sealed window that only measures rules which trade in a bear year
hurt.effect: the window could not see a rule that sat out 2022, so the comparison it produced was not the one anybody wanted
read as a frequency problem for months. Generation four tested that directly and refuted it: the three-to-24 trade count was not the weakness, those trades were simply good ones

open.what: Whether 5m carries edges the 15m book cannot see
open.why: the founding hypothesis of this system, and it has one champion and no second data point

rules: This market has no bell. Any rule that closes, resets or aggregates on a session boundary is importing an assumption from equities.
A sealed window can only measure a rule that actually trades in it - check the trade count before reading the return.
The incumbent bar for this laboratory is +5.05% sealed 2026 (24 trades, 7.88% drawdown). Every later generation is measured against that number.

champion.name: intraday-itsm-30d
champion.mechanism: buys every 1.5% morning move at 06:00 UTC and holds three days; no stop, no trail, no trend filter - all 24 exits were the timer

results.verdict: Frozen. Its sealed +5.05% is the bar the whole laboratory has been trying to beat.
